current_mucositis_grade.label: Current mucositis (current or historical as stated; CTCAE grade)
current_mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade the named event using its own CTCAE criteria; distinguish current findings from previous episodes.

prior_mucositis_grade.label: Previous worst mucositis (current or historical as stated; CTCAE grade)
prior_mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade the named event using its own CTCAE criteria; distinguish current findings from previous episodes.

current_neuropathy_grade.label: Current peripheral neuropathy (current or historical as stated; CTCAE grade)

current_mucositis_grade.label: Current mucositis grade
current_mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess current mucosal symptoms, pain, ulceration and intake. Confirm the anatomical site: the displayed orientation describes oral mucositis; other sites require their exact event criteria. Record prior worst severity separately. NCCP 00420 v4, page 3 Table 3 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.

prior_mucositis_grade.label: Worst previous mucositis grade
prior_mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Record the worst documented previous episode, its site, grading system and recovery. Current improvement must not erase that history. The displayed orientation describes oral mucositis; confirm the exact event for other sites. NCCP 00420 v4, page 3 Table 3 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.

current_neuropathy_grade.label: Current peripheral neuropathy grade
current_neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Document current sensory and motor findings, gait, dexterity and effects on daily activities. Name the exact peripheral event; paraesthesia alone and central neurological toxicity are not interchangeable with peripheral neuropathy. Preserve any previous cisplatin omission separately. NCCP 00420 v4, page 3 Table 3 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.
